domain.name: Radiation Carcinogenesis and Cancer Risk
domain.description: Entities and relationships capturing how low-dose ionising radiation causes cancer, dose-response relationships, and the accuracy of current risk models.
domain.guiding_question: How does low-dose radiation cause cancer, what are the dose-response relationships, and how well do current risk models predict outcomes?

entity_types.name: CANCER_TYPE
entity_types.description: Specific cancer or tumour type induced

entity_types.name: DOSE_RESPONSE_MODEL
entity_types.description: Mathematical model relating dose to cancer risk (LNT, threshold, hormesis)

entity_types.name: POPULATION
entity_types.description: Exposed human or animal population studied

entity_types.name: RISK_ESTIMATE
entity_types.description: Excess relative or absolute cancer risk estimate

entity_types.name: LATENCY
entity_types.description: Time between exposure and tumour development

relationship_types.name: INDUCES
relationship_types.description: Radiation dose induces a cancer type

relationship_types.name: MODELLED_BY
relationship_types.description: A dose-response relationship is described by a model

relationship_types.name: OBSERVED_IN
relationship_types.description: A risk estimate was observed in a population

relationship_types.name: PREDICTS
relationship_types.description: A model predicts risk for a population

queries: low dose radiation cancer risk dose response site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
linear no-threshold model radiation carcinogenesis epidemiology site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
radiation hormesis low dose cancer incidence site:pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov OR site:ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc

in_scope: RADIATION_SOURCE: Source of ionising radiation exposure
DOSE: Quantitative radiation dose (Gy, mSv, cGy)
CANCER_TYPE: Specific cancer or tumour type induced
DOSE_RESPONSE_MODEL: Mathematical model relating dose to cancer risk (LNT, threshold, hormesis)
POPULATION: Exposed human or animal population studied
RISK_ESTIMATE: Excess relative or absolute cancer risk estimate
LATENCY: Time between exposure and tumour development
out_of_scope: Epidemiological population-level cancer statistics unrelated to radiation
